recognize_zh: H&E 400x 為成片的大型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質空泡狀並有多個貼近核膜的核仁（類中心母細胞 centroblast），可見核分裂與凋亡小體，符合大B細胞淋巴瘤的細胞學。
features: Sheets of large lymphoid cells, nuclei about 2-3 times a small lymphocyte
Round to oval, occasionally indented or folded nuclei with vesicular chromatin
One to several small nucleoli, often membrane-bound (centroblast-like)
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Frequent mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies; scattered small vessels and histiocytes
describe_en: High-power section shows sheets of large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, multiple small peripheral nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, consistent with centroblast-like morphology. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily seen. No Reed-Sternberg cells, prominent starry-sky pattern or plasmablastic features are evident. Findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma, and in the context of strong MUM1 expression and IRF4 rearrangement, with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Cytologically identical; IRF4 break-apart FISH with strong MUM1 and young age defines the IRF4-rearranged entity.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple small central nucleoli, squared-off basophilic cytoplasm and a starry-sky background.
FL 3B has follicles of centroblasts but is typically MUM1-negative and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, with strong CD30 and lack of B-cell markers.
